name: ActionList
description: `ActionList` is a semantic action, menu, or listbox list composed from explicit child parts.

props.name: disableItemGap
props.description: Disable the gap between items when this list is rendered in a `NavList`.

props.name: selectionVariant
props.description: How many items may be selected, which also decides the list's ARIA role.

props.name: showDividers
props.description: Draws a divider between items.

props.name: variant
props.description: Density and inset treatment of the list.

props.name: disableItemGap
props.description: Disable the gap between items when this list is rendered in a `NavList`.

props.name: heading
props.description: Supplies the heading region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.Heading` child.

props.name: selectionVariant
props.description: How many items may be selected, which also decides the list's ARIA role.

props.name: showDividers
props.description: Draws a divider between items.

props.name: variant
props.description: Density and inset treatment of the list.

props.name: active
props.description: Highlights the item as the current one, without marking it selected.

props.name: description
props.description: Supplies the description region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.Description` child.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents activation and removes the item from the keyboard order.

props.name: inactiveText
props.description: Marks the item temporarily unavailable and explains why. Unlike `disabled`, the item stays reachable.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Supplies the leadingVisual region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.LeadingVisual` child.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the leading visual, or the trailing visual when there is none, and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the item is loading.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when the item is activated by click or keyboard.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the item selected, reported through the role's selection attribute.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height and label size. Use `small` for dense lists and `large` for a more comfortable touch target.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Supplies the trailingAction region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.TrailingAction` child.

props.name: trailingVisual
props.description: Supplies the trailingVisual region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.TrailingVisual` child.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use `danger` for a destructive action.

props.name: active
props.description: Highlights the link as the current one.

props.name: description
props.description: Supplies the description region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.Description` child.

props.name: inactiveText
props.description: Marks the link temporarily unavailable and explains why. The link renders as text until it is available.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Supplies the leadingVisual region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.LeadingVisual` child.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the link as the current one.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height and label size. Use `small` for dense lists and `large` for a more comfortable touch target.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Supplies the trailingAction region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.TrailingAction` child.

props.name: trailingVisual
props.description: Supplies the trailingVisual region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.TrailingVisual` child.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use `danger` for a destructive navigation.

props.name: heading
props.description: Supplies the heading region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.GroupHeading` child.

props.name: selectionVariant
props.description: Overrides the list's selection behaviour for this group.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading text for the group, as an alternative to supplying a heading child.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element to render, so the group heading fits the surrounding document outline.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Supplies the trailingAction region. Takes precedence over a matching `ActionList.GroupHeading.TrailingAction` child.

props.name: variant
props.description: Use `filled` to give the heading a background and separate it from the items above.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Clips the description to one line instead of wrapping.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the description sits beside the label or on its own line.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element to render, so the list heading fits the surrounding document outline.

props.name: size
props.description: Title size of the heading. Omit it to keep the default large heading font size.

props.name: visuallyHidden
props.description: Hides the heading visually while it still names the list for assistive technology.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: as
props.description:
Renders the action as a button.
Renders the action as a link.

props.name: block
props.description:
Stretches the button to fill the width of its container.
Stretches the link to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description:
Number shown in a trailing counter, for a button that acts on a known quantity.
Number shown in a trailing counter.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Prevents activation and removes the button from the keyboard order.
Prevents navigation and removes the link from the keyboard order.

props.name: href
props.description: Not available on a button action. Use `as="a"` to make the action navigate.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component to render.

props.name: inactive
props.description:
Marks the button temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable, so its reason can be announced.
Marks the link temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the action, since the icon alone conveys nothing.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line instead of being clipped.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses activation.
Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses navigation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description:
Text announced to assistive technology while the button is loading.
Text announced to assistive technology while the link is loading.
